name: Meet Hour
description_en:
Meet Hour provides video meetings with scheduling, moderation, collaboration, recording and streaming features. It also offers developer embedding; MyCaly is a separately named scheduling/video product rather than an automatic Meet Hour entitlement.

The important selection is a hosted meeting account versus a branded/developer integration. Their price units, deployment and setup responsibilities differ, even though both can show a video room.
description_zh:
Meet Hour 提供带排程、主持、协作、录制及直播的视频会议，也提供开发者嵌入。MyCaly 是独立命名的排程/视频产品，不是自动附送的 Meet Hour 权益。

选型应区分托管会议账户与品牌/开发集成。两者虽都显示视频房间，价格单位、部署及配置责任不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Use lobby, screen share, breakout rooms and whiteboard subject to selected plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按所选套餐使用等候室、共享、分组及白板。

core_features.explanation_en: Embedding is explicitly described for Developer and Enterprise.
core_features.explanation_zh: 嵌入明确适用于 Developer 和 Enterprise。

en: Choose the organizer account and plan, schedule a room, invite participants and set lobby access. For a workshop, demonstrate moving participants into a breakout and returning them, then verify recording and shared artifacts separately. The feature page describes unlimited Free duration, but it does not establish every other Free entitlement. No workshop, recording or encryption test was performed.

sections.title_en: Example: a hosted workshop with breakouts
sections.title_zh: 示例：含分组的托管工作坊
sections.en:
Choose the organizer account and plan, schedule a room, invite participants and set lobby access. For a workshop, demonstrate moving participants into a breakout and returning them, then verify recording and shared artifacts separately. The feature page describes unlimited Free duration, but it does not establish every other Free entitlement. No workshop, recording or encryption test was performed.

Before enabling transcription, streaming or donations, confirm language, provider, consent and plan conditions rather than assume every menu feature is included.
sections.zh:
选择组织者账户及套餐、排程房间、邀请参与者并设置等候室。工作坊应演示进入分组再返回，录制和共享资料另外核对。功能页介绍 Free 时长不限，不证明其他 Free 权益都不限。未测试工作坊、录制或加密。

启用转写、直播或捐款前，应确认语言、服务商、同意及套餐条件，不能假设菜单功能全部包含。

sections.title_en: A loaded calculator is not a purchase quote
sections.title_zh: 计算器加载内容不是购买报价
sections.en:
The pricing page offers currency and monthly/quarterly/half-year/yearly controls plus licence and usage models. Much of the plan table remains Loading, and calculator examples show inconsistent zero totals. Although units such as per-minute-per-participant and conference-minute appear, they do not reliably establish a final payable plan. Amounts are left unnormalized.

Ask for the exact plan, participant/concurrent capacity, SDK/embedding rights, recording/streaming/storage costs and tax. The homepage’s five-day trial and starting figure should not substitute for those details. A linked Enterprise Self Host label does not define the licence or operations contract.
sections.zh:
定价页提供货币、月/季/半年/年周期，以及许可和用量模型。大量套餐表仍是 Loading，计算器示例出现不一致零总额。虽可看到每参与者分钟、会议分钟等单位，仍不能可靠得出最终应付方案，因此不归一金额。

应询价确认套餐、参与/并发容量、SDK/嵌入权、录制/直播/存储及税费，不能以首页五天试用和起价替代。Enterprise Self Host 链接标签也不定义许可或运营合同。

sections.en:
Hosts can evaluate workshop controls; developers must separately implement identity, room access and failure handling. Distinguish a successful join from captured media and saved recordings. After a missing artifact, inspect the original room/job before triggering another recording or charge.

No API, SDK, privacy, region, software licence, self-hosted installation or recovery was verified. Documentation descriptions are not independent guarantees of reliability or compliance.
sections.zh:
主持人可评估工作坊控制，开发者还需独立实施身份、房间访问及失败处理。应区分成功加入、媒体采集及录制保存。资料缺失后，重新录制或扣费前先检查原房间/任务。

未核实 API、SDK、隐私、地区、软件许可、自托管安装或恢复，文档说明不是可靠性或合规的独立保证。
